# Import Ticket Data

 This function requires the **Liquids** add-on.

Use the Manual Ticket Import screen to import ticket data using a <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCTextPopup MCTextPopupHotSpot MCTextPopup_Open glossaryTerm MCTextPopupHotSpot_" alt="Closed" data-mc-alt2="Open">TFX file<span class="MCTextPopupBody popupBody"><span class="MCTextPopupArrow"></span>A proprietary binary file format used to import volume and accounting information from run tickets and gauge tickets (pipelines, LACTs, trucks, rail cars, marine vessels, or tank tickets) into FLOWCAL.</span></a> or liquid text file.

The import process can import data for a single ticket or multiple tickets of different types using the same TFX or text file. The tank or location associated with the ticket data must exist in FLOWCAL prior to import.

A prior period adjustment (PPA) is automatically created when an imported ticket is attached to a Location and the ticket effective date is contained in a measurement month in which the location is closed. If a PPA is automatically created for the ticket, a location message will be generated upon import. If the **PPAs Not Allowed** option is enabled (**Settings** \> **Settings Manager** \> **System** \> **System Configuration** \> **PPA Options**), and a ticket is imported for a location that is closed for the month of the effective date of the ticket, the ticket will fail to import and a location message will be generated.

<div class="procedure">

To import a TFX file or text file:

1.  Go to **Import** \> **Ticket Data**.
2.  Click the browse button beside the **Folder or File Name** field to locate a TFX file or text file to import.
3.  Use the drop-down menu in the lower right corner of the File Explorer window to specify whether the import will use a TFX file or text file.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 481;height: 302;" />

1.  Select the import file and click the **Open** button.
2.  Click the **Import** button. A dialogue box will display the status of the import. When the import is complete, the data will be available in the Ticket Editor. Use the Ticket Search function to locate the imported ticket data.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 431;height: 77;" />

</div>

Windows has a hard-coded limit of 260 characters for file paths; file paths longer than this will not work. Importing files from a local install allows for using drive letters for network file paths; however, Citrix resolves the actual network location, which can cause the number of characters in a file path to exceed this limit.
